name: Atenolol
dosing: Hypertension: 25-50mg daily. Angina: 50-100mg daily. Post-MI: 50mg BD. Elderly: start 25mg daily
contraindications: Asthma, severe COPD, cardiogenic shock, severe bradycardia, heart block
interactions: Calcium channel blockers (↑ bradycardia), insulin (masks hypoglycaemia), NSAIDs (↓ antihypertensive effect)
monitoring: Heart rate, blood pressure, signs of heart failure, renal function, glucose (diabetics)
pregnancy: Use with caution; consult UKTIS for guidance
sideEffects: Bradycardia, hypotension, fatigue, cold extremities, bronchospasm, vivid dreams
pharmacokinetics: Low lipophilicity, mainly renal excretion, half-life: 6-7h
clinicalPearls: Less CNS side effects than lipophilic beta-blockers. Reduce dose in renal impairment. Water-soluble
